title: Verdict and Witness
author: Astrid Vane
blurb: Oscar Almeida, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
